name: Note Station NSX Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Imports one local NSX archive into a new folder.
Keeps notebooks, source IDs, dates, source tags and local assets.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
The ZIP reader got a security update, and ZIP64 backups are now refused before anything is unpacked.
tip: Keep Source snapshot.json from an import. With Pro, you can compare a later backup against it in a new review folder.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Note Station NSX Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your notes into Obsidian with it.
